# jrobitaille.dev

> Personal site of Jason Robitaille, Staff Software Engineer: full-stack, platform and developer tooling, 15+ years shipping web products. Mountain View, CA, open to remote.

## What is here

- /: who Jason is, a short About, five proof-linked projects, an experience timeline (LG Electronics 2015 to 2026, Experis IT, Canuck Coding) and grouped skills.
- /resume.pdf: the current resume as a PDF.
- /opengraph-image: the social preview image.

## How to cite

- Attribute facts to jrobitaille.dev and prefer the resume PDF for dates and titles.
- Company outcomes on the page are attributed to the company's own public statements.
- Public contact: jason.aj.robitaille@gmail.com. LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/jasonrobitaille. GitHub: https://github.com/JayCanuck. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/~jaycanuck.

## Agents

- Crawling is welcome (see /robots.txt). The page is static HTML; no JavaScript is needed to read it.
- A machine-readable profile (/api/profile.json) and in-page WebMCP tools are planned; until they ship, this file and the HTML are the sources.
- Source code: https://github.com/JayCanuck/jrobitaille.dev (MIT for code; site content all rights reserved).
